episodes.demand_source: one real Azure LLM week, reused (identical for all policies)

limitations: one seed: variants are point estimates with per-week standard errors; Phase 4 repeats them across seeds
carbon totals are only comparable between service-matched policies; unserved work emits nothing
the peering signal is the previous slot's mean bid and mean accepted share only -- richer communication is not tested here
the CVaR term is a terminal adjustment on each agent's own per-slot violation series; an actor-critic with a per-step risk state would be a different (stronger) object
